scientific_integrity: Explicit self-contained proof; raw finite-field wedge-rank checks are corroboration, not proof of unbounded ranks. No author, priority, or external validation certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Odd-characteristic finite fields only. The all-rank formula concerns the canonical quotient by the fifth power of the augmentation ideal; the full-algebra centralizer spectrum is proved only for five generators. Unindexed literature could contain an equivalent formula; the work has not undergone independent mathematical audit.
title: Commuting-pair threshold in fourth-order Grassmann algebras and the five-generator centralizer spectrum
